primer: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd is an asset-light Indian HNI wealth manager with Rs 1,08,377 Cr in Sep-26 AUM. It earns 59.2% ROCE and 47.3% ROE, passing our Pass 1 business quality gate with watch items. Yet at the Rs 2,387.30 NSE close (MCap Rs 39,792 Cr; Rs 2,375.30 on TradingView), the stock trades at 88.0x TTM P/E and 36.7% Mcap/AUM, yielding -14.05% expected value (Rs 2,051.75). New capital is REJECTED on VALUATION, and sidelined funds stay 100% in cash until a reset toward Rs 1,750-1,850.
